summary: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group filed a Form 6-K announcing progress and completion of a common stock repurchase authorized by the Board on May 15, 2026. Under the program, MUFG repurchased up to 45 million shares (0.40% of outstanding) for up to ¥100 billion. Through June 25, 2026, it bought 31,967,100 shares for ¥99,999,771,608 via Tokyo Stock Exchange market purchases. This is an open-market execution of a board-approved buyback, not a self-tender offer. The repurchase reduces share count and returns capital to shareholders. No timeline for further buybacks was stated. Watch for impacts on EPS and free float.
